verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference and serving engine, and a built-in chat UI is a fair question for local-model runtimes, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents an OpenAI-compatible API server and CLI commands, with no built-in graphical chat interface. Using third-party ChatGPT-style apps against the API is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface
